result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. Excluding the expected horizontally scrollable carousel/clipped edge items and bottom viewport cutoff, one visual defect remains: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation lacks an icon, unlike the other three tabs.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab has no icon above its label, while 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' each display an icon. This leaves an empty gap and makes the tab look broken/inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Add an orders icon (e.g., a receipt or bag outline) above the 'Orders' label, matching the size, stroke weight, and inactive gray color of the other tab icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation labels/icons are not evenly spaced: the 'Orders' label sits lower-aligned with only text (no icon), causing vertical misalignment of the tab contents row compared to the other tabs.
issues.suggestion: Once the Orders icon is added, ensure all four tabs share the same icon+label vertical stack so baselines align across the bar.
